title: Ecommerce SEO in 2026: How to get started - WooCommerce

facts.fact: The page states that Google has over 200 ranking factors, citing Backlinko, a third-party source, rather than a figure from WooCommerce.
The guide recommends that product page copy be between 150 and 300 words.
The guide advises keeping the page title tag under 60 characters.
The guide says a meta description should be about 155 characters long.
The guide states that meta descriptions do not directly affect search ranking but do affect whether someone clicks.
facts.quote: It doesn’t directly affect ranking, but it affects whether someone clicks.

facts.fact: The article was published by Kevin Bates on May 13, 2026.
